_README: Allowlist of Amazon ASINs cleared to appear in src/pages/**/*.astro. Enforced by scripts/lint-content.mjs, which runs in the Saturday deploy gate. An ASIN not listed here FAILS THE BUILD.
_WHY: Three separate incidents shipped dead affiliate links to live money pages: 8 hallucinated ASINs found 2026-07-04, 2 more shipped by the content pipeline 2026-07-20 on /aeron-size-c-vs-leap-plus/, and B0GTJ3YT1B nearly shipped 2026-08-04. Every one earned nothing while sitting on a page with traffic. LLM agents invent plausible-looking 10-character ASINs; an allowlist is the only check that catches that deterministically.
_HOW_TO_ADD: 1. Open https://www.amazon.com/dp/<ASIN> in a browser and confirm the listing loads and the product title matches what the page will claim. 2. Add an entry below with the date and who verified it. Do NOT add an ASIN you have not personally loaded — that is the entire point of this file.
_NOT_AN_HTTP_CHECK: Deliberately not a live HTTP validator. Amazon blocks automated requests (500s / bot walls), so a network check would fail randomly in CI and get ignored. This registry is deterministic and offline.
